params.1266: And By Corn, I Mean Totally Sweet
params.1273: Harvest a crop of sweetcorn from a vegetable patch.
params.1274: To grow sweetcorn you will need three sweetcorn seeds. You can pickpocket these from master farmers (with sufficient Thieving), buy them, or play Vinesweeper for them.
params.1275: Head to a vegetable patch to plant them.
params.1276: Sweetcorn is an ingredient in various Cooking recipes, including tuna potatoes. Plant a scarecrow in a nearby flower patch to protect sweetcorn as it grows.
